host.description: BMC hostname/IP or IPMI URI for remote access (e.g., 'ipmi://user:pass@192.168.1.10:623')

username.description: BMC username for authentication (leave blank to use environment variable or prompt)

password.description: BMC password for authentication (leave blank to use environment variable or prompt)

interface.description: IPMI interface type to use (e.g., 'lanplus' for IPMI 2.0 over LAN)

ciphersuite.description: RMCP+ cipher suite number for 'lanplus' interface (3 = AES-CBC-128)

authlevel.description: RMCP+ authentication level (6 = HMAC-SHA1) for 'lanplus' interface

retries.description: Number of RMCP+ packet retries before failing

verbose.description: Enable verbose debug output (equivalent to '-v' command-line flag)

sol_port.description: SOL payload port number (for 'bridge' mode; 0 = auto-detect)

sol_keepalive.description: Enable periodic keep-alive packets during SOL sessions

sol_idle_timeout.description: SOL session idle timeout in seconds (after which session closes)

sol_baud_rate.description: SOL baud rate divisor (e.g., 9600 = default; 19200 = higher speed)

device.description: Local IPMI device path (used with kernel interface like 'kcs', 'bt')

local_locking.description: Enable file locking on the local device path for safe concurrent access

use_env.description: Allow credentials and settings to be overridden via environment variables
